content.content:
- ADR-0010: the lint tool enforces the § 1.7 table (regex where sound, AST or runtime counters where not), `integer_division` is an error in `src/sim/**` and `src/kernel/**`, shared pure code (`IntMath`, `DetRng`, `Ihash`, `Hex64`, `Hash64`) has a location both `src/sim` and `src/presentation` may import, and the arbitrary-precision test oracle and the golden-update job are provided by the test tooling.
- **`StringName` is never sorted.** `Array.sort()` on `StringName`s is not lexical (P12); convert with `String(k)` first. This is a must-never for canonical ordering and for any sorted iteration.
- `Array.sort_custom` and any sort over keys that can tie are banned in simulation code, because the sort is not stable. A sort that is needed packs the sort key and the stable id into one `int` (`(primary << 20) | id`, with headroom checked) and sorts the `int`s with `Array.sort()`.
- `hash()`, `get_instance_id()`, `ResourceUID`, `shuffle()` and `pick_random()` are banned (engine hash values are not a stable contract; instance ids differ between runs; the other two draw from the global generator).

**1.7 What the lints enforce** (the lint tool is ADR-0010's; this table is the rule set it receives). Where a rule needs more than a regex, the second column says so.

| Rule | Where | Enforced by |
|---|---|---|
| No `randi`, `randf`, `randf_range`, `randi_range`, `randomize`, `seed(`, `rand_from_seed`, `RandomNumberGenerator`, `shuffle`, `pick_random` | `src/sim/**`, `src/kernel/**`, and any presentation file that draws a value a save or a test can observe | regex (allow-list file with a reason per entry) |

### 2. Keyed RNG

- **Model.** One `Thread` per `WriteJob`, its handle held on a `RefCounted` `WriteJob` that also carries the status record. `Thread.start(callable.bind(blocks, paths, ints))` with `PackedByteArray` arguments (probed: works, the caller's array is unchanged; packed arrays are copy-on-write, so the main thread must drop its reference and never mutate after hand-off). **`WorkerThreadPool` is rejected**: it offers no timed wait and its tasks cannot be abandoned individually (training knowledge; **UNVERIFIED** against 4.7, ADR-0010 may confirm). The Save/Load module is the **one** place `Thread` is legal; ADR-0010's lint carries that single exception, scoped to the module's directory.
- **Quit during a write: "bounded join" is bounded polling.** Process exit does not wait on a busy worker (probed: an 8 s sleeping worker did not delay exit past 0.68 s; the engine prints a `~Thread` WARNING and an ObjectDB leak report, which are expected and are ADR-0010's to allow-list). An abandoned worker still running at exit is left to the operating system and its `.tmp` handled by T-6 on the next open. A worker blocked in a syscall rather than a sleep is **UNVERIFIED** (SAVE-WRK-1 d).

decisions.chosen: Layer-first tree: src/shared (L0), src/kernel, src/data, src/save (L1), src/sim/<system> (L2), src/presentation/<system> (L3), src/game (composition root), src/debug and src/observer (dev only); scenes only in presentation, game, debug, observer
decisions.reason: Makes 'simulation never reads presentation', tree-freedom and warning scope directory tests; matches the architecture's module tables; resolves IC-10 (src/sim/sanity/).

decisions.point: Where PROJECTOR scripts and KernelHost live
decisions.chosen: PROJECTOR in src/presentation/projector/; KernelHost in src/game/kernel_host.gd
decisions.reason: Leaves src/sim/** and src/kernel/ with no Node and no per-file exception, so BDY-3 and the kernel GDD's lint are pure directory rules. Allow-list entry if ADR-0001 chooses src/kernel.

decisions.point: Home of shared pure functions (ADR-0007 section 1.9)
decisions.chosen: src/shared/ (IntMath, shared pure helpers, det primitives), importing nothing, importable by every layer including src/data
decisions.reason: src/data may not import src/sim and loaders need the Graph's connectable; ADR-0005 asks for a location importable by sim and presentation.

decisions.chosen: Import-edge matrix checked on class_name tokens via the global class list; presentation names only sim views/ports and kernel facets/ports; data imports shared only; save may type owner views with published sim views/ports; no preload/load of .gd in src
decisions.reason: Mechanises architecture rules 1 to 4; probed that class_name cycles load, so the risk is hidden coupling, not cycles.

decisions.chosen: @abstract base classes ('ports') in the ports/ directory of the lowest layer all consumers may import; owner callables remain registered Callables; ContractCheck (reflection) for recorded stubs; plain push_error base class as documented fallback
decisions.reason: Probed on 4.7.2: missing abstract method and PortBase.new() are parse errors; does not reopen ADR-0003 section 1; 4.7 typed-return inheritance makes missing returns parse errors.

decisions.chosen: SIM-01 token ban (no waiver) over shared, kernel, data, save, sim plus SIM-10 reflection check that blocks are RefCounted; headless harness with injected KernelProfile, Clock, MemoryContentSource; no static var or autoload
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 runs inside a tree so tree-freedom is a lint plus orphan counts, not something a test can arrange.

decisions.point: Test seams in production classes and conditional compilation
decisions.chosen: Seams only in src/<module>/testing/ classes excluded from release export; counters realised by injected WorkCounter port with NullWorkCounter in shipped builds
decisions.reason: GDScript has no preprocessor, so EM_WORK_COUNTER 'compiled in' wording is replaced by injection.

decisions.chosen: One tier: every warning at severity 2 (RETURN_VALUE_DISCARDED 0), none at 1, for all of src/ and tools/
decisions.reason: Probed: severity is global per warning, directory_rules is include/exclude only, and level-1 warnings print nothing headless, so a lax-presentation tier would be invisible to CI.

decisions.chosen: directory_rules {res://: 0, res://addons: 0, res://tests: 0, res://src: 1, res://tools: 1} plus a load-all CI gate (null, can_instantiate() false or SCRIPT ERROR log line)
decisions.reason: Settles BDY-3's unverified directory scope; load() returns a non-null object after a parse error, so the gate needs the extra checks.

decisions.chosen: Excluded for now
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 test code is likely untyped-heavy (UNVERIFIED); revisit after the first 100 tests (open question).

decisions.chosen: Exactly one @warning_ignore('integer_division') in src/, on IntMath.trunc_div; floor_div and posmod_i in IntMath; lexical ban on % and untyped numeric builtins in shared, kernel, sim
decisions.reason: Satisfies TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 repo-wide; probed truncation toward zero and signed %; conflicts with ADR-0005 marker rule (flagged OQ-L).

decisions.chosen: Headless GDScript runner tools/lint/lint_main.gd with a lexical scanner (no AST), reflection tier, and runtime tier; gdtoolkit advisory only
decisions.reason: Reflection and the class map exist only in-engine; ADR-0007 already uses GDScript CI tools; gdtoolkit 4.5.0 documents no @abstract/variadic/4.6-4.7 grammar support (UNVERIFIED).

decisions.point: Which rules each tier can enforce
decisions.chosen: E1 engine (typing, abstract, load-all), E2 lexical (tokens, counts, import graph, tscn/project.godot), E3 reflection (signatures, members, base types), E4 runtime/boot walks (counters, priority walk, identity); every inherited rule in a table with its tier and blind spot
decisions.reason: Answers OQ-16 per rule; field-writer and WriteScope membership are stated as file/function granularity or runtime-only, not hidden.

decisions.chosen: One library: CLI runs before the suite; per-system thin gdUnit4 wrappers under tests/unit/<system>/lint/ assert zero findings; packs at tools/lint/<pack>_lint.gd; content lint stays in tools/ci/
decisions.reason: Satisfies both TR-cmd-051 (tests under tests/unit/kernel/lint) and TR-assembly-044 (harness before the suite, tools/lint/msa_lint.gd) with no losing GDD.

decisions.chosen: '# lint-allow: RULE reason' (10+ chars) per line, waiver-count baseline, named owner per allow-list entry; no-waiver rules for preload, autoload/static var, tree tokens, clock/RNG, physics, Command.new, process_priority literals, FIX-01
decisions.reason: Keeps heuristic false positives from stalling work while the architecture-defining rules stay unconditional.

decisions.chosen: Four checks: HOT-01 token scan of '## @hot' functions, OBJECT_COUNT flat over 600 ticks, MEMORY_STATIC flat on debug binary, is_same and is_read_only identity checks, plus injected work counters
decisions.reason: Probed: OBJECT_COUNT misses arrays; MEMORY_STATIC sees retained (1.7 MB) but not transient allocation (208 B for 100k), so only the token scan catches transient allocation.

decisions.chosen: Pin 6.2.2, committed under addons/gdUnit4 (absent today); exit 101 counts as failure; retry --import once
decisions.reason: 6.2.2 observed on 4.7.2 by the project's reference doc (README lists 4.7.1 only; release page does not mention 4.7); fresh-clone --import crash in 3 of 17 runs.

decisions.chosen: Lane H headless (blocking), lane W windowed for tests/render (runner pending), lane P nightly release-export benchmark; render suites never run in H and are listed SKIPPED; RenderGuard fails zero draw counts; unlisted engine ERROR/WARNING log lines fail H
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-037, TR-percfilter-033, TR-debug-045 need skipped-never-pass; ADR-0006 asks how expected Thread/bytes_to_var noise is tolerated (log allow-list).

decisions.chosen: GDScript only through MVP; ladder rungs 0 to 3; rung 3 only for Graph propagate after S1 evidence on RM-DECK and an accepted amendment; native module implements an @abstract port, GDScript stays golden reference, parity-tested on state_hash; integer-only, -fwrapv; no C#
decisions.reason: Records OQ-10 policy so native code cannot arrive as a convenience and determinism parity is provable.

decisions.chosen: KernelHost, diagnostics timer, plus src/game/monotonic_clock.gd as the production Clock port implementation
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-031 and TR-pc-045 need an injected monotonic clock that something must back; extends ADR-0001's two-file allow-list (flagged).

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: The composition root is src/game/game.gd and KernelHost is src/game/kernel_host.gd (ADR-0001 names the class, not the file); if it is src/kernel/, SIM-01 allow-lists that one file.
Its clock lint allow-list (KernelHost and the diagnostics timer) is extended by src/game/monotonic_clock.gd, the production Clock port implementation (TR-pxl-031, TR-pc-045). Needs agreement.

PresentationClock, ModuleFacet, BlockRegistrar and similar handed-out classes live in src/kernel/facets/; ProcessPriority stays at src/kernel/process_priority.gd; the dev-build boot tree walk (process_priority and effective process_thread_group) runs from src/game/ and from gdUnit4 integration tests.

SurfaceHandle and ControlHandle live in src/kernel/facets/ (nameable by the Input Adapter and Chart Table); Command.new( appears only in src/kernel/; issuer_peer, origin, seq, submission_id never appear as payload keys; bare Dictionary is permitted for command payloads (dictionary allow-list).

SimViews, WriteScope, contexts, descriptors and Command are kernel-internal (not in facets/) so presentation cannot name them; the kernel exposes a dev-build registry dump (commands, hooks, blocks, fault domains) used to generate the published-identifier list; Kernel's member allow-list is a committed file; bare Dictionary is permitted for snapshot/restore signatures. Owner callables stay registered Callables (not reopened).

The notification transport is a kernel-owned observer registry with no engine signals in src/kernel or src/sim (SIM-13 slot); its debug-build dirty-key check runs in the E4 tier; its dirty key is an int.

Pure determinism primitives (IntMath, DetRng, Ihash, Hex64, Hash64) live under src/shared/ (for example src/shared/det/); canonical byte writers stay in src/kernel/det/ (data cannot import them unless the matrix gains a named edge, OQ-E); the strict canonical encoder rejects a float in a snapshot, which is the runtime half of SIM-03; its section 1.7 table becomes pack det_lint.gd, with Dictionary-iteration and StringName-sort rules using ADR-0005's own helper-and-test fallback.

CONFLICT to resolve in joint review: ADR-0005 section 1.7 allows bare / and % with a '# nn:' marker and @warning_ignore in src/sim and src/kernel; ADR-0010 allows exactly one annotated site repo-wide (IntMath.trunc_div) per TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 (OQ-L).

src/save/ is Node-free so SIM-01 applies; FileAccess, DirAccess, JSON, HashingContext and Thread are allowed only under src/save/ (IO-01, IO-02); WorkerThreadPool is unused; Save/Load may type owner-read variables with published sim/<x>/views and sim/<x>/ports classes (matrix cell, OQ-K); expected Thread-exit WARNING, ObjectDB leak report and bytes_to_var ERROR lines go in the lane-H log allow-list (section 8.6).

tools/ci/content_lint.gd and the item-database and Derelict content rule packs stay under tools/ci/; src/data/file_content_source.gd is the only content FileAccess site; ADR-0010 adds exclude_filter globs src/*/testing/* and src/*/*/testing/* to ADR-0007's content_export entry, which the registry forbids editing in place (needs an ADR-0007 amendment or a new entry); shared pure functions (Graph connectable, cap_seam, Derelict BOOT checks) live under src/shared/<owner>/.

Stretch pins and renderer/driver project settings are checked by the PRJ-02 pack (ADR-0008 supplies the values); the windowed lane runs on the renderer and driver ADR-0008 selects; pixel/draw-call checks live under tests/render/.

Presentation references only sim/<x>/views, sim/<x>/ports and kernel/facets classes (read-view facade classes are placed in views/); its presentation lint list (no _physics_process, _process only in registered presenters, no tick_alpha outside the driver, no signal/.connect in kernel or sim) becomes pack presentation_lint.gd plus SIM-13; physics_interpolation off is a PRJ-02 check.
Input.*, InputMap, InputEvent, _input and _unhandled_input are confined by the generic READ-01 allow-list mechanism; ADR-0019 supplies the Adapter file list.

src/debug and src/observer are loaded only by the guarded runtime load() in src/game and are excluded from release by ADR-0031's export gating; ADR-0010 supplies ARCH-03/ARCH-07/ARCH-10 and the testing/ export globs only.
PROJECTOR scripts (Layout and body) live under src/presentation/projector/; ADR-0034 decides the scene shape inside that directory.

open_questions: REGISTRY-ADJACENT CONFLICT: section 4.3 proposes adding exclude_filter globs src/*/testing/* and src/*/*/testing/* to ADR-0007's registered content_export entry; the registry rule is never to modify an existing entry, so ADR-0007 needs an amendment or a new api_decisions entry (registry_candidates lists it only as a referenced_by_update note).

REGISTRY-ADJACENT CONFLICT: section 4.5 adds src/game/monotonic_clock.gd as a third wall-clock reader beyond ADR-0001's registered two-file allow-list (simulation_clock / KernelHost plus diagnostics timer); needs ADR-0001 agreement.

SIBLING CONFLICT (OQ-L): ADR-0005 section 1.7 allows bare / and % with a '# nn:' marker and @warning_ignore in sim/kernel; ADR-0010 allows exactly one annotated integer_division site (IntMath.trunc_div) repo-wide. Align in the joint review or SIM-04/SIM-05 gain a marker mechanism.

OQ-A (user/producer decision): is there hardware and a CI runner for the windowed lane (RM-DESKTOP-class GPU Windows machine, Steam Deck nightly)? Until decided every render AC stays open and the lane report says 'not run'.
OQ-B: should tests/ come into the warning scope later? Excluded now because gdUnit4 test code is likely untyped-heavy (UNVERIFIED).
OQ-C: where does KernelHost live? ADR-0010 assumes src/game/kernel_host.gd; if ADR-0001 uses src/kernel/ one SIM-01 allow-list entry replaces the placement.

OQ-E: ADR-0005 asks for a shared-pure-code location; ADR-0010 assigns src/shared/ (importable by data). If the canonical encoder itself must stay in src/kernel/det/ and be reachable from src/data/, the matrix needs a named data to kernel/det edge.
OQ-F: does gdUnit4-action@v1 fail the job on exit 101? If not, CI must call GdUnitCmdTool.gd directly with an explicit exit-code check.

OQ-G / LINT-SPIKE-1 (gates acceptance): UNVERIFIED on a release export: @abstract survival, can_instantiate() false for a warning-as-error script, MEMORY_STATIC availability, .fixture extension ignored by the editor, gdUnit4 6.2.2 from a committed add-on (addons/gdUnit4 does not exist in the repo yet), pck file-list scan, lint/load-all wall time. Fallbacks are documented for each.
OQ-H: initial contents of the dictionary/Variant allow-list depend on ADR-0002/0003 payload and snapshot shapes; written when the kernel skeleton (KRN-LAT-02) exists.
OQ-I: each performance-bearing ADR (0012, 0014, 0015, 0017, 0028) must list its '## @hot' functions; ADR-0010 provides only the mechanism.

OQ-J: a real AST (probed gdtoolkit version or a project tokenizer) may later tighten field-writer and scope rules; revisit after the first Feature-layer module if the lexical tier's false-negative rate is material.

OQ-K: Save/Load typing its owner-read variables with sim/<x>/views classes is an ADR-0006 assumption; Presentation-to-sim access assumes read-view classes live in sim/<x>/views and Pipeline-root kernel access in kernel/facets (ADR-0009, ADR-0003 to confirm).

OQ-M: ADR-0006's Thread-exit WARNING, ObjectDB leak report and corrupt-input bytes_to_var ERROR lines are tolerated through tests/fixtures/log_allowlist.json (section 8.6); per-test log capture in gdUnit4 6.2.2 is UNVERIFIED.

Acceptance gates: ADR-0001, 0002, 0003 and 0007 must be Accepted and LINT-SPIKE-1 passed; GDD AC wording passes (OQ-16) for 'zero allocation' still follow this ADR. No conflict with any existing registry stance was found; the ADR enforces kernel_autoload_or_global, physics_callback_tick_source, await_process_frame_in_sim_or_presentation, command_constructed_outside_kernel, block_as_resource_or_node, content_directory_scan, mutable_or_resource_catalog and content_file_read through the lint tiers.

toolu_011GEYjBhGqrAEuGFaF3giuW.summary: ADR-0010 (Proposed) fixes a layer-first src/ tree with an import-edge matrix, makes @abstract ports the interface mechanism for injected seams (ADR-0003's registered owner Callables are untouched), and promotes every GDScript warning to an error for src/ and tools/ through the engine's directory_rules, which a 4.7.2 probe showed accept only include/exclude with global severity. It also specifies one headless GDScript lint library (CLI plus gdUnit4 wrappers) with each rule assigned to an engine, lexical, reflection or runtime tier, a four-check restatement of the zero-allocation claim, a pinned gdUnit4 6.2.2 with headless, windowed and benchmark lanes, and a spike-gated GDExtension rung-3 policy; it covers all 38 ADR-0010 TR rows.

decisions.chosen: Layer-first tree: src/shared (L0), src/kernel, src/data, src/save (L1), src/sim/<system> (L2), src/presentation/<system> (L3), src/game (composition root), src/debug and src/observer (dev only); scenes only in presentation, game, debug, observer
decisions.reason: Makes 'simulation never reads presentation', tree-freedom and warning scope directory tests; matches the architecture's module tables; resolves IC-10 (src/sim/sanity/).

decisions.point: Where PROJECTOR scripts and KernelHost live
decisions.chosen: PROJECTOR in src/presentation/projector/; KernelHost in src/game/kernel_host.gd
decisions.reason: Leaves src/sim/** and src/kernel/ with no Node and no per-file exception, so BDY-3 and the kernel GDD's lint are pure directory rules. Allow-list entry if ADR-0001 chooses src/kernel.

decisions.point: Home of shared pure functions (ADR-0007 section 1.9)
decisions.chosen: src/shared/ (IntMath, shared pure helpers, det primitives), importing nothing, importable by every layer including src/data
decisions.reason: src/data may not import src/sim and loaders need the Graph's connectable; ADR-0005 asks for a location importable by sim and presentation.

decisions.chosen: Import-edge matrix checked on class_name tokens via the global class list; presentation names only sim views/ports and kernel facets/ports; data imports shared only; save may type owner views with published sim views/ports; no preload/load of .gd in src
decisions.reason: Mechanises architecture rules 1 to 4; probed that class_name cycles load, so the risk is hidden coupling, not cycles.

decisions.chosen: @abstract base classes ('ports') in the ports/ directory of the lowest layer all consumers may import; owner callables remain registered Callables; ContractCheck (reflection) for recorded stubs; plain push_error base class as documented fallback
decisions.reason: Probed on 4.7.2: missing abstract method and PortBase.new() are parse errors; does not reopen ADR-0003 section 1; 4.7 typed-return inheritance makes missing returns parse errors.

decisions.chosen: SIM-01 token ban (no waiver) over shared, kernel, data, save, sim plus SIM-10 reflection check that blocks are RefCounted; headless harness with injected KernelProfile, Clock, MemoryContentSource; no static var or autoload
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 runs inside a tree so tree-freedom is a lint plus orphan counts, not something a test can arrange.

decisions.point: Test seams in production classes and conditional compilation
decisions.chosen: Seams only in src/<module>/testing/ classes excluded from release export; counters realised by injected WorkCounter port with NullWorkCounter in shipped builds
decisions.reason: GDScript has no preprocessor, so EM_WORK_COUNTER 'compiled in' wording is replaced by injection.

decisions.chosen: One tier: every warning at severity 2 (RETURN_VALUE_DISCARDED 0), none at 1, for all of src/ and tools/
decisions.reason: Probed: severity is global per warning, directory_rules is include/exclude only, and level-1 warnings print nothing headless, so a lax-presentation tier would be invisible to CI.

decisions.chosen: directory_rules {res://: 0, res://addons: 0, res://tests: 0, res://src: 1, res://tools: 1} plus a load-all CI gate (null, can_instantiate() false or SCRIPT ERROR log line)
decisions.reason: Settles BDY-3's unverified directory scope; load() returns a non-null object after a parse error, so the gate needs the extra checks.

decisions.chosen: Excluded for now
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 test code is likely untyped-heavy (UNVERIFIED); revisit after the first 100 tests (open question).

decisions.chosen: Exactly one @warning_ignore('integer_division') in src/, on IntMath.trunc_div; floor_div and posmod_i in IntMath; lexical ban on % and untyped numeric builtins in shared, kernel, sim
decisions.reason: Satisfies TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 repo-wide; probed truncation toward zero and signed %; conflicts with ADR-0005 marker rule (flagged OQ-L).

decisions.chosen: Headless GDScript runner tools/lint/lint_main.gd with a lexical scanner (no AST), reflection tier, and runtime tier; gdtoolkit advisory only
decisions.reason: Reflection and the class map exist only in-engine; ADR-0007 already uses GDScript CI tools; gdtoolkit 4.5.0 documents no @abstract/variadic/4.6-4.7 grammar support (UNVERIFIED).

decisions.point: Which rules each tier can enforce
decisions.chosen: E1 engine (typing, abstract, load-all), E2 lexical (tokens, counts, import graph, tscn/project.godot), E3 reflection (signatures, members, base types), E4 runtime/boot walks (counters, priority walk, identity); every inherited rule in a table with its tier and blind spot
decisions.reason: Answers OQ-16 per rule; field-writer and WriteScope membership are stated as file/function granularity or runtime-only, not hidden.

decisions.chosen: One library: CLI runs before the suite; per-system thin gdUnit4 wrappers under tests/unit/<system>/lint/ assert zero findings; packs at tools/lint/<pack>_lint.gd; content lint stays in tools/ci/
decisions.reason: Satisfies both TR-cmd-051 (tests under tests/unit/kernel/lint) and TR-assembly-044 (harness before the suite, tools/lint/msa_lint.gd) with no losing GDD.

decisions.chosen: '# lint-allow: RULE reason' (10+ chars) per line, waiver-count baseline, named owner per allow-list entry; no-waiver rules for preload, autoload/static var, tree tokens, clock/RNG, physics, Command.new, process_priority literals, FIX-01
decisions.reason: Keeps heuristic false positives from stalling work while the architecture-defining rules stay unconditional.

decisions.chosen: Four checks: HOT-01 token scan of '## @hot' functions, OBJECT_COUNT flat over 600 ticks, MEMORY_STATIC flat on debug binary, is_same and is_read_only identity checks, plus injected work counters
decisions.reason: Probed: OBJECT_COUNT misses arrays; MEMORY_STATIC sees retained (1.7 MB) but not transient allocation (208 B for 100k), so only the token scan catches transient allocation.

decisions.chosen: Pin 6.2.2, committed under addons/gdUnit4 (absent today); exit 101 counts as failure; retry --import once
decisions.reason: 6.2.2 observed on 4.7.2 by the project's reference doc (README lists 4.7.1 only; release page does not mention 4.7); fresh-clone --import crash in 3 of 17 runs.

decisions.chosen: Lane H headless (blocking), lane W windowed for tests/render (runner pending), lane P nightly release-export benchmark; render suites never run in H and are listed SKIPPED; RenderGuard fails zero draw counts; unlisted engine ERROR/WARNING log lines fail H
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-037, TR-percfilter-033, TR-debug-045 need skipped-never-pass; ADR-0006 asks how expected Thread/bytes_to_var noise is tolerated (log allow-list).

decisions.chosen: GDScript only through MVP; ladder rungs 0 to 3; rung 3 only for Graph propagate after S1 evidence on RM-DECK and an accepted amendment; native module implements an @abstract port, GDScript stays golden reference, parity-tested on state_hash; integer-only, -fwrapv; no C#
decisions.reason: Records OQ-10 policy so native code cannot arrive as a convenience and determinism parity is provable.

decisions.chosen: KernelHost, diagnostics timer, plus src/game/monotonic_clock.gd as the production Clock port implementation
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-031 and TR-pc-045 need an injected monotonic clock that something must back; extends ADR-0001's two-file allow-list (flagged).

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: The composition root is src/game/game.gd and KernelHost is src/game/kernel_host.gd (ADR-0001 names the class, not the file); if it is src/kernel/, SIM-01 allow-lists that one file.
Its clock lint allow-list (KernelHost and the diagnostics timer) is extended by src/game/monotonic_clock.gd, the production Clock port implementation (TR-pxl-031, TR-pc-045). Needs agreement.

PresentationClock, ModuleFacet, BlockRegistrar and similar handed-out classes live in src/kernel/facets/; ProcessPriority stays at src/kernel/process_priority.gd; the dev-build boot tree walk (process_priority and effective process_thread_group) runs from src/game/ and from gdUnit4 integration tests.

SurfaceHandle and ControlHandle live in src/kernel/facets/ (nameable by the Input Adapter and Chart Table); Command.new( appears only in src/kernel/; issuer_peer, origin, seq, submission_id never appear as payload keys; bare Dictionary is permitted for command payloads (dictionary allow-list).

SimViews, WriteScope, contexts, descriptors and Command are kernel-internal (not in facets/) so presentation cannot name them; the kernel exposes a dev-build registry dump (commands, hooks, blocks, fault domains) used to generate the published-identifier list; Kernel's member allow-list is a committed file; bare Dictionary is permitted for snapshot/restore signatures. Owner callables stay registered Callables (not reopened).

The notification transport is a kernel-owned observer registry with no engine signals in src/kernel or src/sim (SIM-13 slot); its debug-build dirty-key check runs in the E4 tier; its dirty key is an int.

Pure determinism primitives (IntMath, DetRng, Ihash, Hex64, Hash64) live under src/shared/ (for example src/shared/det/); canonical byte writers stay in src/kernel/det/ (data cannot import them unless the matrix gains a named edge, OQ-E); the strict canonical encoder rejects a float in a snapshot, which is the runtime half of SIM-03; its section 1.7 table becomes pack det_lint.gd, with Dictionary-iteration and StringName-sort rules using ADR-0005's own helper-and-test fallback.

CONFLICT to resolve in joint review: ADR-0005 section 1.7 allows bare / and % with a '# nn:' marker and @warning_ignore in src/sim and src/kernel; ADR-0010 allows exactly one annotated site repo-wide (IntMath.trunc_div) per TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 (OQ-L).

src/save/ is Node-free so SIM-01 applies; FileAccess, DirAccess, JSON, HashingContext and Thread are allowed only under src/save/ (IO-01, IO-02); WorkerThreadPool is unused; Save/Load may type owner-read variables with published sim/<x>/views and sim/<x>/ports classes (matrix cell, OQ-K); expected Thread-exit WARNING, ObjectDB leak report and bytes_to_var ERROR lines go in the lane-H log allow-list (section 8.6).

tools/ci/content_lint.gd and the item-database and Derelict content rule packs stay under tools/ci/; src/data/file_content_source.gd is the only content FileAccess site; ADR-0010 adds exclude_filter globs src/*/testing/* and src/*/*/testing/* to ADR-0007's content_export entry, which the registry forbids editing in place (needs an ADR-0007 amendment or a new entry); shared pure functions (Graph connectable, cap_seam, Derelict BOOT checks) live under src/shared/<owner>/.

Stretch pins and renderer/driver project settings are checked by the PRJ-02 pack (ADR-0008 supplies the values); the windowed lane runs on the renderer and driver ADR-0008 selects; pixel/draw-call checks live under tests/render/.

Presentation references only sim/<x>/views, sim/<x>/ports and kernel/facets classes (read-view facade classes are placed in views/); its presentation lint list (no _physics_process, _process only in registered presenters, no tick_alpha outside the driver, no signal/.connect in kernel or sim) becomes pack presentation_lint.gd plus SIM-13; physics_interpolation off is a PRJ-02 check.
Input.*, InputMap, InputEvent, _input and _unhandled_input are confined by the generic READ-01 allow-list mechanism; ADR-0019 supplies the Adapter file list.

src/debug and src/observer are loaded only by the guarded runtime load() in src/game and are excluded from release by ADR-0031's export gating; ADR-0010 supplies ARCH-03/ARCH-07/ARCH-10 and the testing/ export globs only.
PROJECTOR scripts (Layout and body) live under src/presentation/projector/; ADR-0034 decides the scene shape inside that directory.

open_questions: REGISTRY-ADJACENT CONFLICT: section 4.3 proposes adding exclude_filter globs src/*/testing/* and src/*/*/testing/* to ADR-0007's registered content_export entry; the registry rule is never to modify an existing entry, so ADR-0007 needs an amendment or a new api_decisions entry (registry_candidates lists it only as a referenced_by_update note).

REGISTRY-ADJACENT CONFLICT: section 4.5 adds src/game/monotonic_clock.gd as a third wall-clock reader beyond ADR-0001's registered two-file allow-list (simulation_clock / KernelHost plus diagnostics timer); needs ADR-0001 agreement.

SIBLING CONFLICT (OQ-L): ADR-0005 section 1.7 allows bare / and % with a '# nn:' marker and @warning_ignore in sim/kernel; ADR-0010 allows exactly one annotated integer_division site (IntMath.trunc_div) repo-wide. Align in the joint review or SIM-04/SIM-05 gain a marker mechanism.

OQ-A (user/producer decision): is there hardware and a CI runner for the windowed lane (RM-DESKTOP-class GPU Windows machine, Steam Deck nightly)? Until decided every render AC stays open and the lane report says 'not run'.
OQ-B: should tests/ come into the warning scope later? Excluded now because gdUnit4 test code is likely untyped-heavy (UNVERIFIED).
OQ-C: where does KernelHost live? ADR-0010 assumes src/game/kernel_host.gd; if ADR-0001 uses src/kernel/ one SIM-01 allow-list entry replaces the placement.

OQ-E: ADR-0005 asks for a shared-pure-code location; ADR-0010 assigns src/shared/ (importable by data). If the canonical encoder itself must stay in src/kernel/det/ and be reachable from src/data/, the matrix needs a named data to kernel/det edge.
OQ-F: does gdUnit4-action@v1 fail the job on exit 101? If not, CI must call GdUnitCmdTool.gd directly with an explicit exit-code check.

OQ-G / LINT-SPIKE-1 (gates acceptance): UNVERIFIED on a release export: @abstract survival, can_instantiate() false for a warning-as-error script, MEMORY_STATIC availability, .fixture extension ignored by the editor, gdUnit4 6.2.2 from a committed add-on (addons/gdUnit4 does not exist in the repo yet), pck file-list scan, lint/load-all wall time. Fallbacks are documented for each.
OQ-H: initial contents of the dictionary/Variant allow-list depend on ADR-0002/0003 payload and snapshot shapes; written when the kernel skeleton (KRN-LAT-02) exists.
OQ-I: each performance-bearing ADR (0012, 0014, 0015, 0017, 0028) must list its '## @hot' functions; ADR-0010 provides only the mechanism.

OQ-J: a real AST (probed gdtoolkit version or a project tokenizer) may later tighten field-writer and scope rules; revisit after the first Feature-layer module if the lexical tier's false-negative rate is material.

OQ-K: Save/Load typing its owner-read variables with sim/<x>/views classes is an ADR-0006 assumption; Presentation-to-sim access assumes read-view classes live in sim/<x>/views and Pipeline-root kernel access in kernel/facets (ADR-0009, ADR-0003 to confirm).

OQ-M: ADR-0006's Thread-exit WARNING, ObjectDB leak report and corrupt-input bytes_to_var ERROR lines are tolerated through tests/fixtures/log_allowlist.json (section 8.6); per-test log capture in gdUnit4 6.2.2 is UNVERIFIED.

Acceptance gates: ADR-0001, 0002, 0003 and 0007 must be Accepted and LINT-SPIKE-1 passed; GDD AC wording passes (OQ-16) for 'zero allocation' still follow this ADR. No conflict with any existing registry stance was found; the ADR enforces kernel_autoload_or_global, physics_callback_tick_source, await_process_frame_in_sim_or_presentation, command_constructed_outside_kernel, block_as_resource_or_node, content_directory_scan, mutable_or_resource_catalog and content_file_read through the lint tiers.

data.summary: ADR-0010 (Proposed) fixes a layer-first src/ tree with an import-edge matrix, makes @abstract ports the interface mechanism for injected seams (ADR-0003's registered owner Callables are untouched), and promotes every GDScript warning to an error for src/ and tools/ through the engine's directory_rules, which a 4.7.2 probe showed accept only include/exclude with global severity. It also specifies one headless GDScript lint library (CLI plus gdUnit4 wrappers) with each rule assigned to an engine, lexical, reflection or runtime tier, a four-check restatement of the zero-allocation claim, a pinned gdUnit4 6.2.2 with headless, windowed and benchmark lanes, and a spike-gated GDExtension rung-3 policy; it covers all 38 ADR-0010 TR rows.

registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- pattern: preload_or_load_of_script_in_src
    status: active           # ADR-0010 is Proposed
    description: "No preload, load or ResourceLoader of a .gd path anywhere in src/ (reference other systems by class_name); non-script preload only in src/presentation and src/game; the one guarded load() of the dev roots in src/game is the sole exception. No waiver (ARCH-03)."

registry_candidates.name: float_or_wall_clock_in_sim
registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- pattern: float_or_wall_clock_in_sim
    status: active           # ADR-0010 is Proposed
    description: "No float declaration, float literal, Vector2/Vector3/Transform2D, Time.*, get_process_delta_time, Engine frame counters or global RNG (randi, randf, randomize, RandomNumberGenerator, shuffle, pick_random) in src/shared and src/sim; kernel and data confine floats and clock reads to the SIM-02 and float allow-lists (kernel_host.gd, monotonic_clock.gd, the diagnostics timer, presentation_clock.gd, *_read.gd)."
    why: "Kernel H9, determinism by construction; a float or a wall-clock read that reaches state breaks replay and the state hash."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0010-source-layout-static-typing-and-lint-enforcement.md
    added: 2026-10-28

registry_candidates.name: integer_division_outside_int_math
registry_candidates.entry_yaml:
- pattern: integer_division_outside_int_math
    status: active           # ADR-0010 is Proposed; conflicts with ADR-0005 section 1.7 marker rule (OQ-L)
    description: "Integer / and % are used only inside IntMath; there is exactly one @warning_ignore(\"integer_division\") in src/, on IntMath.trunc_div; min, max, clamp, abs, sign, floor, ceil, round are not used on simulation values (use mini, maxi, clampi, absi, signi)."
    why: "Negative operands truncate toward zero and % keeps the sign (probed on 4.7.2); one tested site removes the class of off-by-one bugs in tile, pixel and rate math."
    adr: docs/architecture/adr-0010-source-layout-static-typing-and-lint-enforcement.md
    added: 2026-10-28

decisions.chosen: Layer-first tree: src/shared (L0), src/kernel, src/data, src/save (L1), src/sim/<system> (L2), src/presentation/<system> (L3), src/game (composition root), src/debug and src/observer (dev only); scenes only in presentation, game, debug, observer
decisions.reason: Makes 'simulation never reads presentation', tree-freedom and warning scope directory tests; matches the architecture's module tables; resolves IC-10 (src/sim/sanity/).

decisions.point: Where PROJECTOR scripts and KernelHost live
decisions.chosen: PROJECTOR in src/presentation/projector/; KernelHost in src/game/kernel_host.gd
decisions.reason: Leaves src/sim/** and src/kernel/ with no Node and no per-file exception, so BDY-3 and the kernel GDD's lint are pure directory rules. Allow-list entry if ADR-0001 chooses src/kernel.

decisions.point: Home of shared pure functions (ADR-0007 section 1.9)
decisions.chosen: src/shared/ (IntMath, shared pure helpers, det primitives), importing nothing, importable by every layer including src/data
decisions.reason: src/data may not import src/sim and loaders need the Graph's connectable; ADR-0005 asks for a location importable by sim and presentation.

decisions.chosen: Import-edge matrix checked on class_name tokens via the global class list; presentation names only sim views/ports and kernel facets/ports; data imports shared only; save may type owner views with published sim views/ports; no preload/load of .gd in src
decisions.reason: Mechanises architecture rules 1 to 4; probed that class_name cycles load, so the risk is hidden coupling, not cycles.

decisions.chosen: @abstract base classes ('ports') in the ports/ directory of the lowest layer all consumers may import; owner callables remain registered Callables; ContractCheck (reflection) for recorded stubs; plain push_error base class as documented fallback
decisions.reason: Probed on 4.7.2: missing abstract method and PortBase.new() are parse errors; does not reopen ADR-0003 section 1; 4.7 typed-return inheritance makes missing returns parse errors.

decisions.chosen: SIM-01 token ban (no waiver) over shared, kernel, data, save, sim plus SIM-10 reflection check that blocks are RefCounted; headless harness with injected KernelProfile, Clock, MemoryContentSource; no static var or autoload
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 runs inside a tree so tree-freedom is a lint plus orphan counts, not something a test can arrange.

decisions.point: Test seams in production classes and conditional compilation
decisions.chosen: Seams only in src/<module>/testing/ classes excluded from release export; counters realised by injected WorkCounter port with NullWorkCounter in shipped builds
decisions.reason: GDScript has no preprocessor, so EM_WORK_COUNTER 'compiled in' wording is replaced by injection.

decisions.chosen: One tier: every warning at severity 2 (RETURN_VALUE_DISCARDED 0), none at 1, for all of src/ and tools/
decisions.reason: Probed: severity is global per warning, directory_rules is include/exclude only, and level-1 warnings print nothing headless, so a lax-presentation tier would be invisible to CI.

decisions.chosen: directory_rules {res://: 0, res://addons: 0, res://tests: 0, res://src: 1, res://tools: 1} plus a load-all CI gate (null, can_instantiate() false or SCRIPT ERROR log line)
decisions.reason: Settles BDY-3's unverified directory scope; load() returns a non-null object after a parse error, so the gate needs the extra checks.

decisions.chosen: Excluded for now
decisions.reason: gdUnit4 test code is likely untyped-heavy (UNVERIFIED); revisit after the first 100 tests (open question).

decisions.chosen: Exactly one @warning_ignore('integer_division') in src/, on IntMath.trunc_div; floor_div and posmod_i in IntMath; lexical ban on % and untyped numeric builtins in shared, kernel, sim
decisions.reason: Satisfies TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 repo-wide; probed truncation toward zero and signed %; conflicts with ADR-0005 marker rule (flagged OQ-L).

decisions.chosen: Headless GDScript runner tools/lint/lint_main.gd with a lexical scanner (no AST), reflection tier, and runtime tier; gdtoolkit advisory only
decisions.reason: Reflection and the class map exist only in-engine; ADR-0007 already uses GDScript CI tools; gdtoolkit 4.5.0 documents no @abstract/variadic/4.6-4.7 grammar support (UNVERIFIED).

decisions.point: Which rules each tier can enforce
decisions.chosen: E1 engine (typing, abstract, load-all), E2 lexical (tokens, counts, import graph, tscn/project.godot), E3 reflection (signatures, members, base types), E4 runtime/boot walks (counters, priority walk, identity); every inherited rule in a table with its tier and blind spot
decisions.reason: Answers OQ-16 per rule; field-writer and WriteScope membership are stated as file/function granularity or runtime-only, not hidden.

decisions.chosen: One library: CLI runs before the suite; per-system thin gdUnit4 wrappers under tests/unit/<system>/lint/ assert zero findings; packs at tools/lint/<pack>_lint.gd; content lint stays in tools/ci/
decisions.reason: Satisfies both TR-cmd-051 (tests under tests/unit/kernel/lint) and TR-assembly-044 (harness before the suite, tools/lint/msa_lint.gd) with no losing GDD.

decisions.chosen: '# lint-allow: RULE reason' (10+ chars) per line, waiver-count baseline, named owner per allow-list entry; no-waiver rules for preload, autoload/static var, tree tokens, clock/RNG, physics, Command.new, process_priority literals, FIX-01
decisions.reason: Keeps heuristic false positives from stalling work while the architecture-defining rules stay unconditional.

decisions.chosen: Four checks: HOT-01 token scan of '## @hot' functions, OBJECT_COUNT flat over 600 ticks, MEMORY_STATIC flat on debug binary, is_same and is_read_only identity checks, plus injected work counters
decisions.reason: Probed: OBJECT_COUNT misses arrays; MEMORY_STATIC sees retained (1.7 MB) but not transient allocation (208 B for 100k), so only the token scan catches transient allocation.

decisions.chosen: Pin 6.2.2, committed under addons/gdUnit4 (absent today); exit 101 counts as failure; retry --import once
decisions.reason: 6.2.2 observed on 4.7.2 by the project's reference doc (README lists 4.7.1 only; release page does not mention 4.7); fresh-clone --import crash in 3 of 17 runs.

decisions.chosen: Lane H headless (blocking), lane W windowed for tests/render (runner pending), lane P nightly release-export benchmark; render suites never run in H and are listed SKIPPED; RenderGuard fails zero draw counts; unlisted engine ERROR/WARNING log lines fail H
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-037, TR-percfilter-033, TR-debug-045 need skipped-never-pass; ADR-0006 asks how expected Thread/bytes_to_var noise is tolerated (log allow-list).

decisions.chosen: GDScript only through MVP; ladder rungs 0 to 3; rung 3 only for Graph propagate after S1 evidence on RM-DECK and an accepted amendment; native module implements an @abstract port, GDScript stays golden reference, parity-tested on state_hash; integer-only, -fwrapv; no C#
decisions.reason: Records OQ-10 policy so native code cannot arrive as a convenience and determinism parity is provable.

decisions.chosen: KernelHost, diagnostics timer, plus src/game/monotonic_clock.gd as the production Clock port implementation
decisions.reason: TR-pxl-031 and TR-pc-045 need an injected monotonic clock that something must back; extends ADR-0001's two-file allow-list (flagged).

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: The composition root is src/game/game.gd and KernelHost is src/game/kernel_host.gd (ADR-0001 names the class, not the file); if it is src/kernel/, SIM-01 allow-lists that one file.
Its clock lint allow-list (KernelHost and the diagnostics timer) is extended by src/game/monotonic_clock.gd, the production Clock port implementation (TR-pxl-031, TR-pc-045). Needs agreement.

PresentationClock, ModuleFacet, BlockRegistrar and similar handed-out classes live in src/kernel/facets/; ProcessPriority stays at src/kernel/process_priority.gd; the dev-build boot tree walk (process_priority and effective process_thread_group) runs from src/game/ and from gdUnit4 integration tests.

SurfaceHandle and ControlHandle live in src/kernel/facets/ (nameable by the Input Adapter and Chart Table); Command.new( appears only in src/kernel/; issuer_peer, origin, seq, submission_id never appear as payload keys; bare Dictionary is permitted for command payloads (dictionary allow-list).

SimViews, WriteScope, contexts, descriptors and Command are kernel-internal (not in facets/) so presentation cannot name them; the kernel exposes a dev-build registry dump (commands, hooks, blocks, fault domains) used to generate the published-identifier list; Kernel's member allow-list is a committed file; bare Dictionary is permitted for snapshot/restore signatures. Owner callables stay registered Callables (not reopened).

The notification transport is a kernel-owned observer registry with no engine signals in src/kernel or src/sim (SIM-13 slot); its debug-build dirty-key check runs in the E4 tier; its dirty key is an int.

Pure determinism primitives (IntMath, DetRng, Ihash, Hex64, Hash64) live under src/shared/ (for example src/shared/det/); canonical byte writers stay in src/kernel/det/ (data cannot import them unless the matrix gains a named edge, OQ-E); the strict canonical encoder rejects a float in a snapshot, which is the runtime half of SIM-03; its section 1.7 table becomes pack det_lint.gd, with Dictionary-iteration and StringName-sort rules using ADR-0005's own helper-and-test fallback.

CONFLICT to resolve in joint review: ADR-0005 section 1.7 allows bare / and % with a '# nn:' marker and @warning_ignore in src/sim and src/kernel; ADR-0010 allows exactly one annotated site repo-wide (IntMath.trunc_div) per TR-shipbody-002 and TR-emitter-034 (OQ-L).

src/save/ is Node-free so SIM-01 applies; FileAccess, DirAccess, JSON, HashingContext and Thread are allowed only under src/save/ (IO-01, IO-02); WorkerThreadPool is unused; Save/Load may type owner-read variables with published sim/<x>/views and sim/<x>/ports classes (matrix cell, OQ-K); expected Thread-exit WARNING, ObjectDB leak report and bytes_to_var ERROR lines go in the lane-H log allow-list (section 8.6).

tools/ci/content_lint.gd and the item-database and Derelict content rule packs stay under tools/ci/; src/data/file_content_source.gd is the only content FileAccess site; ADR-0010 adds exclude_filter globs src/*/testing/* and src/*/*/testing/* to ADR-0007's content_export entry, which the registry forbids editing in place (needs an ADR-0007 amendment or a new entry); shared pure functions (Graph connectable, cap_seam, Derelict BOOT checks) live under src/shared/<owner>/.

Stretch pins and renderer/driver project settings are checked by the PRJ-02 pack (ADR-0008 supplies the values); the windowed lane runs on the renderer and driver ADR-0008 selects; pixel/draw-call checks live under tests/render/.

Presentation references only sim/<x>/views, sim/<x>/ports and kernel/facets classes (read-view facade classes are placed in views/); its presentation lint list (no _physics_process, _process only in registered presenters, no tick_alpha outside the driver, no signal/.connect in kernel or sim) becomes pack presentation_lint.gd plus SIM-13; physics_interpolation off is a PRJ-02 check.
Input.*, InputMap, InputEvent, _input and _unhandled_input are confined by the generic READ-01 allow-list mechanism; ADR-0019 supplies the Adapter file list.

src/debug and src/observer are loaded only by the guarded runtime load() in src/game and are excluded from release by ADR-0031's export gating; ADR-0010 supplies ARCH-03/ARCH-07/ARCH-10 and the testing/ export globs only.
PROJECTOR scripts (Layout and body) live under src/presentation/projector/; ADR-0034 decides the scene shape inside that directory.
